hypothesis_contract.null: Restricting V29 peer membership to the active same-signed USD inventory subgraph does not produce positive RAW walk-forward equity or does not make both full comparable months reach 2.0x under both normal and adverse costs.
hypothesis_contract.alternative: The local active same-signed USD inventory peer scope removes nonlocal market-wide votes while preserving V29 release math and improves RAW edge enough for both full comparable months to reach 2.0x under normal and adverse costs.

training_only_scope_selection.selection_basis: All seven instruments are USD crosses, so plain currency-node adjacency gives every pair the same six peers and would only rename V29. The selected scope uses the completed pre-decision inventory-induced graph and includes only peers that already share the target sleeve's signed USD inventory exposure.

peer_scope_rule.name: ACTIVE_SAME_SIGNED_USD_INVENTORY_SUBGRAPH
peer_scope_rule.currency_graph: Each pair is an edge between its non-USD currency leaf and the central USD node. Potential adjacency alone is market-wide and therefore identical to V29. V30 induces a local subgraph from inventory present immediately before the release decision.
peer_scope_rule.base_quote_to_usd_sign: For USD_QUOTE pairs, usd_sign(direction) = -direction. For USD_BASE pairs, usd_sign(direction) = direction. +1 means long USD exposure and -1 means short USD exposure.
peer_scope_rule.scope_formula: S_p(t-) = {q != p | a completed V25 signal for q exists at t AND q inventory is open at t- after max-age processing AND usd_sign(q_position) = usd_sign(p_position)}
peer_scope_rule.shared_currency_exposure: Every included peer is an already instantiated inventory edge sharing the central USD node and the same signed USD exposure as the target. Unheld signal pairs and active opposite-signed USD inventory are outside the local component.
peer_scope_rule.why_more_local_than_v29: V29 admits every simultaneous non-self USD-cross signal, including pair nodes with no current basket inventory. V30 admits only signals attached to the target's current same-signed USD inventory component.
peer_scope_rule.completed_data_chronology: At each exact integer epoch-nanosecond timestamp: apply per-pair elapsed max-age closes at the current completed open; snapshot the remaining inventory graph; form every target scope and release decision from that immutable snapshot and simultaneous frozen V25 signal batch; apply releases simultaneously; then apply unchanged V29 own-pair signal actions; then completed-close MTM and terminal liquidation.
peer_scope_rule.vote_units: signed USD direction votes per scoped simultaneous signal
peer_scope_rule.release_formula_unchanged_from_v29: release iff |S_p(t-)| >= 2 and abs(sum(vote(q))) = |S_p(t-)| and usd_sign(p_position) * sign(sum(vote(q))) < 0
peer_scope_rule.tie_missing_or_peer_shortage: Mixed votes, missing completed bar, no active same-signed inventory, or fewer than two scoped peers deterministically preserve the unchanged V29 state.
peer_scope_rule.own_pair_signal: No consensus release is evaluated; unchanged V29 same-direction hold or opposite-direction reverse applies.
peer_scope_rule.weekend_gap: Use the first completed executable open at or after the unchanged 48-hour target; the unchanged 96-hour hard observed age cap remains mandatory.
peer_scope_rule.terminal_liquidation: Close every remaining sleeve at the last completed bar close of each evaluation period and realize terminal MTM.

cost_arm_contract.raw_price: mid open/close with no spread, slippage, commission, or financing
cost_arm_contract.base_price: frozen V7 executable BID/ASK, slippage, commission, financing, and frozen decision-to-fill chronology
cost_arm_contract.adverse_price: frozen V7 adverse BID/ASK, slippage, commission, financing, and frozen decision-to-fill chronology

rejection_contract.system_fail: Any frozen hash, RAW identity, chronology, arm-transition parity, source, cap, max-age, terminal liquidation, MTM, authority, holdout, period, leverage, threshold, or one-variable mismatch fails closed.
rejection_contract.profit_reject: Automatically reject if either full comparable month is below 2.0x in EXECUTABLE_BASE or ADVERSE_STRESS, or unopened holdout reproduction is absent.
rejection_contract.raw_edge_reason: CONSENSUS_RELEASE_SCOPE_RAW_EDGE_ABSENT when walk-forward RAW equity is at or below 1.0.
